unit: CH-02 refresh continuity — RC1 and RC7 shared-cause corrections
contract: REFRESH IS NOT NAVIGATION — reloading on a legitimate destination must reconstruct that destination (founder-frozen).
method: Executed against the existing shared-cause audit (docs/2026-08-17-refresh-continuity-shared-causes.md), which ranks nine root causes and orders the widest-leverage corrections. Corrections 1 and 7 were taken; the audit was not re-derived.

RC1.auditFinding: Web session restore gated behind a device-local hint boolean. The hint was written by only two sign-in paths, destroyed on transient refusal, and lost when SharedPreferences throws — every downstream gate then fired correctly against a FALSE unauthenticated premise.
RC1.alreadyFixedBeforeThisPass: The WRITE half. The hint is now written inside TokenStore.setSession — the choke point every authentication path funnels through — and cleared in clearTokens. Verified in code before assuming the audit was still current.
RC1.whatRemained: The READ half. `hasSessionHint()` collapsed three different facts into one boolean: a session existed, no session ever existed, and THIS BROWSER WILL NOT ANSWER. Private browsing makes SharedPreferences throw, so 'I cannot know' was being read as 'definitely never signed in' — and the restore was skipped for a signed-in person on every reload.
correction: SessionHintStatus tri-state — present / absent / unavailable — with readSessionHintStatus(). `unavailable` is never treated as `absent`.
A pure decision function, decideWebSessionRestore(status, landingPath), so the rule is testable without a browser, a router or a clock.
The hint stays an OPTIMISATION applied only where it was ever justified: a fresh tab landing on a genuinely public page. Everywhere else Aura asks.
RC1.theRuleNow: Restore is attempted unless the hint is definitively absent AND the landing path classifies PUBLIC (and is not the router's own /_boot). Cost of asking wrongly: one 401 in the console. Cost of skipping wrongly: a person loses their place.
RC1.unknownRoutesFailTowardAsking: classifyRoute already fails closed to MEMBER, so an unclassified route (RC6's gap, untouched here) costs a speculative refresh rather than a lost destination.
RC1.identityCeremoniesProtected: /complete-identity and /verify-pending classify AUTH_ACTION, not PUBLIC, so a reload mid-ceremony now restores instead of stranding the person.
RC1.hygieneWinPreserved: The original reason for the hint — no blind `401 Missing refresh token` on /, /public, /privacy, /mission, /login — is kept exactly, and a test asserts that EVERY skip in the whole decision space is that one case.

RC7.auditFinding: Draft surfaces never write identity into the URL. The Article editor called createDraft() on EVERY mount of /articles/write and never replaced the URL with /articles/write/<id>.
RC7.consequence: A reload did not reopen the article being written — it minted ANOTHER empty draft and left the real work unreachable, one orphan row per refresh. This is also the founder-reported 'draft not resumable' defect.
RC7.correction: On creating a draft the editor now context.replace()s to NavigationAuthority.articleEditorRoute(id). `replace`, not `push`: the id-less address was never a place worth going back to, and Back should leave the editor rather than return to a route that would mint yet another draft.
RC7.scope: The ARTICLE half only. The Compose half of RC7 (compose_screen's in-memory _draftPostId) is untouched and remains owed.
RC7.authorityReused: NavigationAuthority.articleEditorRoute — the canonical builder, which the audit noted existed and was simply unused here.

deliberatelyNotDone.RC2_RC3: Institution route redirects and path-id dominance. Genuinely available, materially larger, and touching institution routing — kept out of a batch whose corrections are provably independent.
deliberatelyNotDone.RC4_RC5_RC6_RC8_RC9: Not attempted this pass. Recorded as remaining, not silently dropped.

filesChanged: aura_final/lib/core/auth/session_bootstrap.dart (consumes the decision, landing path from Uri.base)

stateTransitions.F059: OPEN — unchanged. RC1 removes one of its three root causes (RC1 of RC1/RC2/RC3); RC2 and RC3 remain.
stateTransitions.F063: OPEN — unchanged. The Article surface is corrected; the Compose surface (RC7's other half) and RC8 remain.
stateTransitions.honesty: NO finding is claimed closed or advanced by this batch. A shared root cause was removed; the findings above it stay OPEN until their remaining causes are corrected and certified. Claiming otherwise would be exactly the state inflation the register forbids.

protectedBoundaries.meetings: UNTOUCHED — no meeting route, guard or session path modified
protectedBoundaries.guestSessions: UNCHANGED — guest tokens still deliberately do not write the hint
protectedBoundaries.authenticationAuthority: Reused, not bypassed: the decision governs only WHETHER the cold refresh is attempted, never who is authenticated
